scope: Read-only current machine inventory; no installations or global PATH changes

components.jdk17: ABSENT (R04 standard-path scan; java command absent)

disk.basis: Planning estimate for JDK, Android command-line tools, platform/build tools, NDK, CMake, Android templates, Gradle caches and temporary archives. Exact package sizes are not stated in the cited Godot setup instructions and were not downloaded or measured.

exact_install_plan.jdk: Install an owner-approved OpenJDK 17 distribution into a task-specific path under %LOCALAPPDATA% (not system-wide); verify java -version.
exact_install_plan.sdkmanager_bootstrap: Install Android SDK Command-line Tools (latest) into a task-specific Android SDK root under %LOCALAPPDATA%.
exact_install_plan.licenses: Owner must review and accept Android SDK package licenses using sdkmanager --licenses.
exact_install_plan.godot_templates: Download/install Android export templates matching Godot 4.7.2 using the editor template manager after owner approval.
exact_install_plan.godot_config: Configure Godot Java SDK Path and Android SDK Path to isolated roots; do not edit global PATH.
exact_install_plan.verification: Check java -version, sdkmanager --list_installed, adb version, cmake --version, NDK source.properties, Godot Android templates and export preset; run debug export only after approval.

approval: OWNER_APPROVAL_REQUIRED for multi-gigabyte downloads, license acceptance, SDK/JDK/template install, editor settings and device export/install.
